entry.content: • (Google Cloud CLI) The google-cloud-sdk Snap package will be deprecated and removed on September 29th, 2026. Please migrate to the google-cloud-cli package. For more information, see https://docs.cloud.google.com/sdk/docs/downloads-snap.
entry.summary: The google-cloud-sdk Snap package will be deprecated and removed on September 29th, 2026. Users should migrate to the google-cloud-cli package to avoid service disruption. Further details and migration instructions can be found in the official documentation.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: Snap package for Google Cloud CLI to be removed

entry.content: • Fixed Google Compute Engine residency detection to prevent authentication failures due to transient issues and command latency regressions in non-Google Cloud environments.
entry.summary: Compute Engine residency detection has been fixed to avoid authentication failures caused by temporary issues and command latency in non-Google Cloud environments. This update ensures smoother operation and more reliable authentication.
entry.title: Google Cloud CLI: Compute Engine residency detection improved

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud apihub locations configure-and-deploy-server command to GA. This command configures and deploys an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server on Apigee X via API Hub.
entry.summary: The `gcloud apihub locations configure-and-deploy-server` command is now generally available. This command simplifies the deployment of an MCP server on Apigee X through API Hub, streamlining your API management workflow.
entry.title: Apihub: API Hub Server Deployment Now Generally Available

entry.content:
• Added first-party activation support to gcloud privateca subordinates activate via --issuer-pool, --issuer-location, and --issuer-ca flags.
  • Added suggestion to use gcloud privateca subordinates activate when gcloud privateca subordinates create with issuer flags fails due to an already existing subordinate CA.
entry.summary: You can now activate subordinate Certificate Authorities using the `gcloud privateca subordinates activate` command with new issuer flags. The tool also suggests this activation command if creating a subordinate CA fails because it already exists.
entry.title: Certificate Authority Service: Subordinate CA Activation

entry.content: • Added --tags flag to gcloud certificate-manager create commands (certificates create, dns-authorizations create, issuance-configs create, maps create, and trust-configs create).
entry.summary: The Certificate Manager now supports tags for its create commands, including certificates, DNS authorizations, issuance configurations, maps, and trust configurations. This enhancement allows for better organization and management of your resources within the Certificate Manager.
entry.title: Certificate Manager: New tagging capabilities for Certificate Manager

entry.content:
• Added selective disk backup properties (boot-disk-only and disk-exclusion-labels) under --compute-instance-properties in gcloud backup-dr backup-plans create and update commands.
  • Added --source-instance-boot-disk and --source-instance-disk-device-name flags to gcloud backup-dr backups restore disk for individual disk restore from compute instance backup.
entry.summary: New options allow for more granular control over Compute Engine instance backups, including selective disk backups and individual disk restores. This provides greater flexibility in managing your data protection strategies.
entry.title: Cloud Backup DR: Enhanced backup and restore for Compute Engine instances

entry.content:
• Enabled the 'backfill' Airflow CLI sub-command for Composer environments running Airflow 3.
  • Enabled the 'config lint' Airflow CLI sub-command for Composer environments running Airflow 2.11.0 or higher.
entry.summary: We've enabled the 'backfill' Airflow CLI sub-command for Composer environments running Airflow 2. We've also enabled the 'config lint' Airflow CLI sub-command for Composer environments running Airflow 2.11.0 or higher.
entry.title: Cloud Composer: New Airflow CLI Commands Available

entry.content:
• Added gcloud dataflow jobs pause and gcloud dataflow jobs resume commands.
  • Added --enable-turnkey-alerts flag to gcloud dataflow jobs run and gcloud dataflow flex-template run.
entry.summary: New commands are available to pause and resume Dataflow jobs, enhancing control over your data processing pipelines. Additionally, a new flag, `--enable-turnkey-alerts`, has been introduced for `gcloud dataflow jobs run` and `gcloud dataflow flex-template run` to simplify alert configuration.
entry.title: Cloud Dataflow: Dataflow job management updates

entry.content: • Added support for X.509 certificate-based credentials and locational mTLS endpoints to gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create-cred-config.
entry.summary: The `gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create-cred-config` command now supports X.509 certificate-based credentials and locational mTLS endpoints. This enhances security for workload identity configurations.
entry.title: Cloud IAM: Secure workload identity with certificates

entry.content: • Update gcloud spanner backups list command to display INSTANCE_PARTITIONS column in GA track.
entry.summary: The `gcloud spanner backups list` command now displays the INSTANCE_PARTITIONS column. This update is generally available and provides more detailed information about your Spanner backups.
entry.title: Cloud Spanner: Spanner backups list command updated

entry.content:
• gcloud storage rsync:
  • Skipping syncing files which goes outside of destination directory.
entry.summary: The `gcloud storage rsync` command now prevents files from being synced outside the destination directory, enhancing data safety. This update ensures that your synchronization operations remain within the intended boundaries.
entry.title: Cloud Storage: Cloud Storage Sync Safety Update

entry.content: • Updated gcloud cluster-director clusters create to default to dynamic nodes when using flex start.
entry.summary: Cluster Director now defaults to dynamic nodes for flex start when creating clusters. This update enhances flexibility and resource management for your cluster deployments.
entry.title: Cluster Director: Cluster Director: Dynamic Nodes Default

entry.content:
• Added gcloud compute resource-policies test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine resource policy in GA, beta, preview, and alpha.
  • Added gcloud compute snapshot-groups set-iam-policy command in beta.
  • Added --kms-key-service-account to gcloud compute disks create, gcloud compute images create, gcloud compute machine-images create and gcloud compute snapshots create for beta track.
  • Added --boot-disk-kms-key-service-account and --instance-kms-key-service-account to gcloud compute instances create and gcloud compute instance-templates create for beta track.
  • Added --consistent-hash-minimum-ring-size flag to gcloud compute backend-services create and update commands.
  • Added --circuit-breakers-max-requests flag to gcloud compute backend-services create and update commands.
  • Added gcloud compute backend-services test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine backend service in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added gcloud compute ssl-policies test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine SSL policy in beta.
  • Added gcloud compute firewall-policies test-iam-permissions command.
  • Promoted --graceful-shutdown, --graceful-shutdown-max-duration, and --no-graceful-shutdown flags to the GA track for gcloud compute instances and gcloud compute instance-templates commands.
  • Added --identity-type flag to gcloud compute instances create, gcloud compute instances update, and gcloud compute instance-templates create in alpha.
  • Promoted exapool capacity flags to beta and GA tracks for gcloud compute storage-pools update command.
  • Added --maintenance-freeze-duration and --clear-maintenance-freeze-duration flags to gcloud compute instances set-scheduling and gcloud compute instances create in beta.
  • Added gcloud compute images test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine image in beta, preview, and GA.
entry.summary: New commands and flags have been added to the Compute Engine command-line interface, including enhanced IAM permission testing, KMS key service account support for disks and images, and improved backend service configurations. Several features related to graceful shutdown and maintenance freeze have also been promoted to GA and beta tracks.
entry.title: Compute Engine: Compute Engine CLI Updates

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud device-run sessions wait command to beta.
  • Updated --instrumentation-timeout flag of gcloud beta device-run sessions submit instrumentation to allow a maximum duration of 3 hours.
  • Updated gcloud device-run devices describe to display hardware_type instead of form.
  • Updated gcloud device-run devices list to display HARDWARE_TYPE column instead of FORM.
entry.summary: The `gcloud device-run sessions wait` command has been promoted to beta. Additionally, several commands have been updated to improve user experience and provide more detailed hardware information.
entry.title: Device Run: Device Run beta improvements

entry.content: • Promoted API field schema for --fleet-default-member-config flag on gcloud container fleet|hub config-management enable command to beta.
entry.summary: The Fleet default member configuration API for the `gcloud container fleet config-management enable` command has been promoted to beta. This change applies to the `--fleet-default-member-config` flag, offering enhanced capabilities for managing your fleet's configurations.
entry.title: GKE Hub: Fleet Config Management API Promoted to Beta

entry.content:
• Updated gcloud beta metastore services migrations start to support migrations to Lakehouse runtime catalog(s).
  • Deprecated Cloud SQL migration arguments in gcloud beta metastore services migrations start.
entry.summary: Metastore now supports migrations to Lakehouse runtime catalogs. The `gcloud beta metastore services migrations start` command has been updated accordingly. Note that Cloud SQL migration arguments for this command are now deprecated.
entry.title: Metastore: Metastore Migrations Enhanced for Lakehouse Runtime

entry.content: • Added --export-psc-published-services-and-regional-google-apis and --export-psc-global-google-apis flags to gcloud beta network-connectivity hubs create and gcloud beta network-connectivity hubs update commands.
entry.summary: We've added new flags to the `gcloud beta network-connectivity hubs create` and `gcloud beta network-connectivity hubs update` commands. These flags allow you to export published services and regional or global Google APIs. This enhances the flexibility and control you have over your network connectivity.
entry.title: Network Connectivity: New options for network connectivity hubs

entry.content:
• Promoted mcp and policyProfile fields to GA in gcloud network-security authz-policies import and export commands.
  • Made loadBalancingScheme optional in gcloud network-security authz-policies import and export commands.
entry.summary: The network security authorization policies feature is now generally available. Key fields like `mcp` and `policyProfile` are promoted to GA, and `loadBalancingScheme` is now optional in import and export commands.
entry.title: Network Security: Network Security Authorization Policies Now Generally Available

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud network-services telemetry-policies delete command to BETA.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: The `gcloud network-services telemetry-policies delete` command has been promoted to BETA. This command allows you to manage telemetry policies for your network services. Subscribe to release notes for future updates.
entry.title: Network Services: Network telemetry policies command promoted to BETA
